messages:
maria: Quick sync — joint webinar with NovaCloud + IntegrateCo next Wed. Need final speaker confirmations, demo failover plan, and swag shipping owner. Agenda attempt below.
alex: Agenda looks good. who is confirming speakers?
maria: @jamie will handle keynote slide deck, @raj to own live demo. @sophie (NovaCloud) & @ben (IntegrateCo) please confirm speaker slots.
sophie: NovaCloud good for 6 min keynote + 10 min demo. We'll bring USB demo kit. shipping ETA Fri.
ben: IntegrateCo confirmed 10 min SI case study + 5 min Q&A. We might need remote vpn to access customer lab.
raj: For live demo, prefer recording fallback. options: 1) local recording + play; 2) switch to hosted demo on devdedicated.redwood.ai. Prefer 2 for interactivity.
maria: Action items: speaker confirmations by EOD Mon, demo fallback decided, swag lead. jamie?
jamie: I'll own swag. Planning 300 sticker packs + 75 demo postcards. Need ship-by date = Tue. Can partners provide swag co-brand assets?
sophie: NovaCloud can do co-branded stickers (eps/png). send specs.
ben: IntegrateCo can cover fulfillment in NA, need address list from @alex.
alex: I'll export list from events sheet and share link: https://redwood-internal/drive/evt-webinar-shiplist
maria: We'll set on-call for event: @deploy-bot to post channel 15m before. raj set runbook?
raj: Draft runbook snippet below:
```bash
# runbook excerpt
connect-ssh demo-host --proxy
start-demo --model gpt-4o-mini --seed 42
if demo-fails: curl -X POST https://hooks.example/fallback -d '{"mode":"playback"}'
```
alex: LGTM. Add "slide-share fallback" note.
maria: Timeline: Mon EOD speakers, Tue build check, Wed morning dry-run 9am PT, Wed live 11am PT. confirm availability.
sophie: NovaCloud dry-run 9am works.
ben: IntegrateCo ok.
raj: available.
jamie: ok.
maria: Small ask: can partners send swag tracking numbers to jamie + cc me?
sophie: yes.
ben: yes.
maria: thanks all. I'll follow up with calendar invite & final runbook. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: webinar dry-run in 24h — thread pinned.
alex: adding checklist item: "recording permission forms" — @legal ping please?
maria: @taylor-legal can you confirm recording release language?
taylor-legal: confirmed, use template at /legal/consent-template.docx
maria: perfect. Closing loop — will update thread when slides + assets arrive.
